_comment: Vol 19 (Old Town / Lincoln Park, ~650-3000 N east of ~1400 W) -> modern renames. VOLUME-SCOPED. Source: 'Chicago Streets', William Martin 1948 (CHM street-name-changes list, http://chsmedia.org/househistory/nameChanges/start.pdf, accessed 2026-07-25). Each entry was spot-checked against the sheets; HAMILTON CT->GENEVA (Geneva Terrace, not Larrabee: Larrabee is read as a separate street on the same sheets). BLACK HAWK and THE LAKE SHORE are spelling/article variants of current streets, not renames. MARCY->MARCEY and HIGH->JANSSEN were added 2026-07-26; both supersede a step-2/step-3 disposition. HIGH: Martin's '-High St., Janssen Ave., 1420W fr. 2200 to 2799N' is exactly the Clybourn/Southport-corridor High St the step-3 record described - Janssen measures 103 m over p4/p5/p22 against Burton Pl's 2891 m, and the p4 numerals 2289-2369 sit inside Martin's 2200-2799N. MARCY: '-Marcy St., Marcey St. 1000W' is a spelling normalization, not the erasure step 2 assumed - Marcey St is in the modern reference, measures 113 m over four sheets against Wood St's 1596 m, and the p51/p52/p55 numerals 1623-1953 sit inside Martin's 1634-1943N.
_comment2: Deliberately NOT aliased: NURSERY (in Martin 1948 as a current street, since erased from the modern grid), GROVE PL. (Martin's '-Grove Ct. & Pl., Shakespeare Ave. 600 to 700W' does not reach the reads' locality - modern Shakespeare measures 1613 m from p12/p18 - and the court guard means these reads only ever see a full-string key).
_comment3: HAND REMOVAL 2026-07-26: the sweep auto-wrote LAFAYETTE CT -> WALTON as a unique in-bounds candidate, but the candidate is not unique. Martin's only line naming the court form is '-Lafayette Pl., or Ct., Seneca St. 835 to 950N.', and Seneca St was itself renamed to Mies van der Rohe Way ('-Seneca St., 235E 500 to 920N. ... LaFayette Pl., Meis Van der Rohr Way.'). The proposer cannot chain a rename through a second rename, so the rival dropped out for want of a SENECA index key. Measured on p115/p124 against the alias-free index: WALTON 90 m, MIES VAN DER ROHE 137 m - inside the 400 m accept bar and clearing neither the 2x nor the 300 m margin, so this key belongs in the HELD tier and needs a per-entry sheet check. A re-sweep with --force will propose it again.
